feeds.title: Frankenmuth Woolen Mill Blog
feeds.description: The Frankenmuth Woolen Mill is a Midwestern woolen mill since 1894 creating natural, organic, wool bedding. We work every day to provide you with a path to better sleep, whether it comes from our wool comforters, wool pillows, or both. Our products are made with the finest all-natural and organic materials available.

feeds.title: Koigu Blog
feeds.description: Follow along on the Koigu farm, as different departments give advice and share stories regarding the ongoing adventures in the shop! Koigu's palette and designs are fearless, bold, and luminous with a spark of life in each creation.

feeds.title: Knomad Blog
feeds.description: In this blog of undyed yarns, you will know the most complete information about Knomad products. We're specialists in worldly natural fibers, blending them for just the right balance of strength, softness, and elasticity. Our lineup includes classic favorites like merino sock yarn, as well as exciting new blends like our hemp and wool yarn, Bristle.

feeds.title: International Wool Textile Organisation
feeds.description: The International Wool Textile Organisation is the global authority for standards in the wool textile industry. With 33 members in 22 countries, IWTO's membership encompasses all stages of the wool textile pipeline. From farm to retail, through research, education, and knowledge sharing, IWTO ensures a sustainable future for wool.

feeds.title: Woolen Mill Store
feeds.description: Bringing you crafty news and inspo from the Pendleton Woolen Mill Store. The Woolen Mill store is your source for first-quality Pendleton fabrics, remnants, and notions for sewing and crafting. We offer an extensive selection of Pendleton's iconic apparel, blankets, and home goods, as well as an array of decor and more from trusted vendors.

feeds.title: Sonoma Wool Company Blog
feeds.description: Amy started Sonoma Wool Company with a genuine passion for wool and its incredible properties. We value sustainable concepts, from cradle to grave. The driving purpose of Sonoma Wool Company is to help people Re-Discover the Wonders of Wool, which, of course, will help support family sheep ranches.

feeds.title: SweetGeorgia Yarns Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2005 by Felicia Lo, SweetGeorgia Yarns is an artisan yarn company that is passionate about bringing you stunningly saturated colors, luxurious natural fibers, and yarns of the highest quality. It is a yarn and fiber arts company that creates luxury hand-dyed yarn, fiber, patterns, goods, and education for a global community to bring joy.

feeds.title: Shetland Wool Week Blog
feeds.description: Shetland Wool Week is a world-renowned celebration of Britain's most northerly native sheep, the Shetland textile industry, and the rural farming community on these islands. Shetland wool is a world-class natural fiber, with a long-standing reputation for quality, strength, and excellence from fleece to textile products.

feeds.title: Brown Sheep Company Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Brown Sheep blog! We post monthly updates on a wide variety of topics, from our latest products to project inspiration and tutorials. Our blog covers all kinds of fiber arts - knitting, crochet, weaving, spinning, and more! Be sure to check out our yarns, and patterns, and learn more.

feeds.title: With Wool Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is April Klich. I write about knitting, spinning, and straight up making with a focus on playing and finding joy in the process.

feeds.title: The Twisted Yarn
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome. I'm Phil. Here is my blog, all about knitting and crocheting color into my home in the Oxfordshire countryside. When I'm not busy with yarn, I'm a clinical psychologist and mother of small twins. I also write a quarterly column for Simply Knitting magazine.

feeds.title: Purl Soho » Knitting
feeds.description: Read about new knitting, sewing, crochet, embroidery, weaving, and craft projects. We are inspired by traditional fiber arts, modern design, and nature's creations. From traditional Peruvian alpaca to rose gold scissors manufactured in Sheffield, England, our products are made by people who care as much as we do about quality and integrity.

feeds.title: Yarn Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Yarn Gallery offers an abundant array of fibers, colors, textures, and inspiration for your hand-knitting and crocheting adventures. Our goal is to offer the best in yarns and tools, classes and teachers, service, and enthusiasm, all working together to help you make beautiful and successful projects.

feeds.title: Chester Wool Co Blog
feeds.description: At Chester Wool Co, we manufacture and wholesale a range of more than 200 natural undyed yarns for hand-dye artists. We supply all yarn weights from 1600 metres per 100g to 40 metres per 100g, and the majority of our stock is in 100 gram hanks, ready for the dye pot. We use superior natural fibres to create this stunning range.

feeds.title: Bare Naked Wools Blog
feeds.description: Bare Naked Wools by Knitspot is all about creating quality natural yarns that travel straight from farm to fingers. Bare Naked Wools label yarns are custom blended and naturally sourced with no harmful chemicals or dyes. Better for the earth, better for animals, and better for knitters looking to elevate their projects.

feeds.title: Woolcool Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest updates from Woolcool on its latest innovation and news for sustainable, biodegradable, and eco packaging. Woolcool was launched in 2008 and the innovative, sustainable design has scooped an impressive haul of awards in the packaging, business, and environmental arenas. It remains the only packaging company using a range of sheep wool insulated packaging available on a commercial scale.

feeds.title: World's Finest Wool Blog
feeds.description: World's Finest Wool is a website created to inspire passion for the unsurpassed wools used around the world. It presents not only the exquisite fibers themselves but also the geographical and environmental conditions of each region.

feeds.title: Mountain Meadow Wool Blog
feeds.description: Hear from Mountain Meadow Wool owners about daily life at the mill. Read new product highlights. Mountain Meadow Wool is a family-operated mill dedicated to supporting local ranchers and raising awareness about ranching culture across the American West.

feeds.title: Good Wool Hunting Blog
feeds.description: Good Wool Hunting is a family-run business, dedicated to providing the discerning fibrephile with an ever-expanding collection of beautiful yarns and must-have accessories. Whether you're a seasoned yarn enthusiast or just beginning to explore the craft, their blog offers a tapestry of delightful anecdotes and useful resources.

feeds.title: Jimmy Beans Wool Blog
feeds.description: A personal and business blog written by the owners and employees of the yarn shop Jimmy Beans Wool. Jimmy Beans is your local yarn store in person and online! Endless Yarn, Hooks, Needles. & More for Makers!

feeds.title: Babes in the Wool
feeds.description: Welcome to Babes in the Wool's blog! Stay up-to-date with our newest stock additions and general goings on, learn more about the different parts of our shop, read free In the Wool articles, and more!

feeds.title: J&S Blog
feeds.description: Real Shetland WoolJamieson & Smith Shetland Wool Brokers are an icon of the British Wool industry and are part of the Campaign for Wool. Our ultimate goal is to encourage the breeding of pure-bred Shetland Sheep and to play our part in ensuring the sustainability of Shetland's crofting and textiles industries, and the heritage and culture surrounding these industries.

feeds.title: Solidwool
feeds.description: Solidwool was born from the idea to create something beautiful - and to create a sustainable design with an unbreakable link to nature and our surroundings. We want to create a natural material that is beautiful with a story that connects people to the land it has come from.

feeds.title: Wool and Palette Blog
feeds.description: I am Emily of Wool & Palette, and I create naturally hand-dyed yarn. I am determined to change how we make clothes by sourcing wool from sheep treated responsibly and raised with a progressive approach to land management. I strive to breathe new life into this lost craft by creating a range of deeply saturated colors you want to wear.

feeds.title: Wooly Witch of the West Blog
feeds.description: A blog about natural dyeing, hand spinning, knitting, and other fiber arts. Madeline has had a deep love of the wild lands of Montana since she was a child and a fascination with fiber arts that began with knitting 16 years ago. During that time her depth of study in this field of art has grown to include: hand-spinning on spindle and wheel, natural dyeing, weaving & embroidery.

feeds.title: Halcyon Yarn's Blog
feeds.description: For over 50 years we've delivered the best quality yarns, fibers, and tools for weaving, knitting, spinning, dyeing, felting, and more, to fiber artists worldwide. Natural fibers, handmade textiles, and helping you find success in your craft are the inspiration for everything we do.

feeds.title: Flywool Blog
feeds.description: Get exclusive purchase tips from Flywool Blog. We will continue to update the product information so that customers understand our products. If you want to get the latest product information. Fly wool, With more than 10 years of experience in processing wool in China. Our factory has a strict quality control system. The quality of goods is the same as the sample quality.
